name: mcp_builder
description: Guide for building high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that let LLMs interact with external services through well-designed tools. Covers Python (FastMCP) and Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK) implementations, tool design, error handling, and pagination. Use when integrating a new external API into JARVIS or the browser as a tool source. Ported from Anthropic's mcp-builder.
